event: ThunderTalk Gaming vs Team WE — Game 1

leanRationale.handicapArithmetic: Assuming the lean was assessed at the recorded 7:43 snapshot, TT led by two kills. TT +9.5 would lose only if TT finished at least ten kills behind, so WE needed a net twelve-kill swing from that snapshot. That was a meaningful cushion rather than a marginal number.
leanRationale.functionalReturnDamage: TT had two clear damage channels in Ryze and Ziggs. The recorded state showed TT already producing kills and did not document a carry, lane, or role collapse at the time of the lean.
leanRationale.targetAccessAndCounterplay: Jarvan IV, K'Sante, and Shen provided engage, counter-engage, peel, and cleanup routes. Ziggs and Ryze also supplied waveclear and ranged return damage, reducing the probability of repeated completely clean WE fights.
leanRationale.nextFightStressTest: A plausible clean WE fight of roughly three to five unanswered kills would damage the position but would not by itself consume the full twelve-kill net swing required from the snapshot. The cushion therefore survived a conservative single-fight stress test at lean level.
leanRationale.initialStructuralRead: Gold was nearly even and the available record did not show a major tower, objective, or map-access deficit at the lean snapshot. There was therefore no recorded structural state forcing TT into repeated prepared-terrain entries at that moment.

whyNotOfficial.missingTwoConversions: The official positive-underdog kill-handicap gate required two qualifying structured-fight conversions. The recorded 3-1 kill lead did not establish two independent structured conversions.
whyNotOfficial.incompleteSynchronizedState: The files do not preserve the exact tower, dragon, Grub, wave, vision, summoner-spell, item, and gold-distribution state at the original lean decision.
whyNotOfficial.priceNotVerified: Quoted odds were not recorded, so minimum-odds compliance and value versus the target and hard floors could not be verified.
whyNotOfficial.draftIsSupportNotProof: TT's draft supplied credible theoretical return-kill routes, but composition theory and an early kill lead were insufficient for official promotion without stronger observed fight and structural confirmation.
whyNotOfficial.probationSelectivity: Under v0.3.18, selectivity is mandatory and a marginal gate pass should remain a watch rather than become an official wager.

processReview.initialDecisionGrade: Justified LEAN — 0u watch based on a large live cushion, functioning theoretical return damage, credible counterplay, and no recorded collapse at the snapshot.
processReview.officialVetoGrade: Correctly not promoted because the two-conversion gate, complete synchronized-state verification, and price verification were absent.
processReview.laterThesisStatus: Expired after WE won a 4v4 structured fight and secured three Void Grubs.
processReview.expiryInterpretation: That later sequence materially changed objective control and the reliability of TT's return-kill thesis, so any unplaced recommendation required reassessment rather than carrying forward.
processReview.outcomeInterpretation: The final winning settlement supports the original cushion direction but does not retroactively reverse the later expiry decision or convert the watch into an official bet.
processReview.sameMapRule: Any re-entry would still have required two new qualifying structured-fight conversions, stabilization, restored functionality, and explicit repair of the original failure condition.

sourceLimitations: The original quoted odds were not preserved.
The exact timestamp of the recommendation is inferred to align with the recorded 7:43 snapshot.
No complete synchronized item, tower, objective, wave, vision, or summoner-spell panel was preserved for the initial lean.
